code: # Define a set of colors between two endpoints create_color_range(c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), 5) #> [1] "#2166AC" "#45538C" "#6A3F6C" "#8E2C4B" "#B2182B"  # Assign a color to multiple entries create_color_range("steelblue", 3) #> [1] "#4682B4" "#4682B4" "#4682B4"  # Select a single color from a range create_color_range(c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), 1) #> [1] "#6A3F6C" create_color_range(c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), 1, single_color = "first") #> [1] "#2166AC" create_color_range(c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), 1, single_color = "last") #> [1] "#B2182B"
